notes: TRANSLATION: 高度 = height, 宽度 = width, 厚度 = thickness, 展开 = unfolded, 折叠 = folded, 重量 = weight, 尺寸（英寸） = size in inches, 内屏 = inner screen, 外屏 = cover screen, 分辨率 = resolution, 刷新率 = refresh rate, 屏幕比例 = screen ratio, 屏幕材质 = screen material, 上市时间 = launch/on-sale time. vivo uses no 约 anywhere, so these figures are exact as published. COLOURWAY VARIANTS: 厚度 is published three ways — 菱紫 (Rhombus Purple) 8.19mm 展开 / 17.56 折叠; 钻黑 (Diamond Black) 7.75mm 展开 / 16.62 折叠; 绸金 (Silk Gold) 7.84mm 展开 / 16.80 折叠 — and 重量 as 菱紫、钻黑：198g / 绸金：199g. I recorded the 钻黑 (Diamond Black) depths together with its matching 198 g mass so the entry describes one real configuration; the other colourways differ as listed. Note vivo omits the 'mm' unit on the folded figures ('、16.62（折叠）') — transcribed exactly as published. Height and width are shared across colourways. CAUTION: the LLM-rendered WebFetch of this page mis-assigned 菱紫 as 7.75/16.62; the raw Nuxt payload quoted above is what I actually used. announced AND released LEFT NULL: the only date vivo publishes is 上市时间 '2023年4月' (April 2023) — month precision only, which cannot be written as YYYY-MM-DD without inventing a day; the exact launch date appears only on secondary sites, so it is omitted. hinge.crease: '全新 5.3mm 超大直径水滴设计' = 'all-new 5.3mm extra-large-diameter waterdrop design' -> teardrop. hinge.free_stop = true from '悬停视话' ('hover video call') and '悬停蔡司影像'/'悬停自拍' ('hover ZEISS imaging'/'hover selfie') on the product page. materials.cover_glass 'UTG' from 'UTG 超韧玻璃，折痕隐形' = 'UTG ultra-tough glass, invisible crease' — vivo states this for the INNER folding display only; no glass is named for the cover screen, and no frame/back material row exists, so those stay null. panel recorded as OLED per the SPEC enum; vivo's literal wording is a single device-level 屏幕材质 AMOLED row, not split per screen (contrast IS split: 内屏 8000000:1 / 外屏 6000000:1). Inner refresh_hz records the stated maximum of '内屏：60Hz;120Hz'. controls left empty (not surveyed; vivo does list 指纹识别 侧边电容指纹, a side capacitive fingerprint). || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence). Preserved verbatim here so a human can re-source rather than re-research: hinge.type = 'flip'; hinge.axis = 'short'.
